items.title: 13.8.2 Silver halides (AgX) ka aabi ammonia se reaction (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.8.2 with Table 13.6, printed pages 298-299.

blocks.text: Aabi ammonia dalna silver halide precipitates ki solubility ka test karta hai. AgF pani mein halne wala hai aur precipitate nahi deta, to ammonia ka koi asar nahi. Silver chloride ka safed precipitate dilute ammonia mein hal ho kar diamminesilver(I) complex ka be-rang solution deta hai: AgCl(s) + 2NH3(aq) se [Ag(NH3)2]+(aq) + Cl-(aq). Silver bromide ka cream precipitate ghaliz ammonia mein halta hai, be-rang solution bhi deta hua: AgBr(s) + 2NH3(aq) se [Ag(NH3)2]+ + Br-. Silver iodide ka peela precipitate dilute ya ghaliz ammonia mein nahi halta, to koi tabdeeli nahi hoti. Table 13.6 silsile ka khulasa deti hai.

blocks.caption: Halides par Ag+ aur phir ammonia ka amal (Table 13.6)

blocks.prompt: KI ke Ag+ aur phir NH3 ke saath muadle likhein aur batayein ke kya dekha jata hai; aur ammonia mein silver halides ki mukhtalif solubilities ki wazahat karein (Quick Check 13.4b, c).
blocks.explanation: KI(aq) + AgNO3(aq) se AgI(s) + KNO3(aq): halka peela precipitate. Ammonia, dilute ya ghaliz, dalne par kuch nahi badalta; peela solid rehta hai. Ammonia silver halide ko [Ag(NH3)2]+ complex bana kar halti hai, jo lattice se muqabla karta hai: AgCl teenon mein sab se zyada halne wala hai, to dilute ammonia kaafi hai; AgBr kam halne wala hai aur ghaliz ammonia mangta hai; AgI itna na-halne wala hai ke complex kaafi Ag+ solution mein nahi kheench sakta.

items: AgCl dilute NH3 mein halta hai, AgBr sirf ghaliz NH3 mein (dono be-rang [Ag(NH3)2]+ dete hain), AgI kisi mein nahi; AgF kabhi precipitate nahi hota. Table 13.6 ba-zabta silsila deti hai.
